scripts.check: prettier --check src *.json *.mjs quality/*.mjs && stylelint 'src/**/*.css' --max-warnings 0 && ast-grep scan --rule no-css-comments.yml src && node quality/check.mjs
scripts.build: export LC_ALL=C; mkdir -p dist && cat src/tokens.css src/remnote.css src/components/*.css > dist/theme.css && rm -f dist/cosmic.zip && zip -qjX dist/cosmic.zip dist/theme.css manifest.json README.md assets/logo.png
